cast.title: The Turning
cast.overview: Seventeen talented Australian directors from diverse artistic disciplines each create a chapter of the hauntingly beautiful novel by multi award-winning author Tim Winton. The linking and overlapping stories explore the extraordinary turning points in ordinary people’s lives in a stunning portrait of a small coastal community. As characters face second thoughts and regret, relationships irretrievably alter, resolves are made or broken, and lives change direction forever.

cast.title: The Water Diviner
cast.overview: In 1919, Australian farmer Joshua Connor travels to Turkey to discover the fate of his three sons, reported missing in action. Holding on to hope, Joshua must travel across the war-torn landscape to find the truth and his own peace.

cast.title: The Big Dog
cast.overview: A few hours before his son’s graduation party, an alpha stockbroker must frantically scramble to raise a fortune before his unsuspecting wife discovers that his financial dominance mistress drained their bank accounts.

cast.title: Sleeping Beauty
cast.overview: A haunting erotic fairytale about Lucy, a young University student drawn into a mysterious hidden world of beauty and desire.

cast.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales
cast.original_title: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales
cast.overview: Thrust into an all-new adventure, a down-on-his-luck Capt. Jack Sparrow feels the winds of ill-fortune blowing even more strongly when deadly ghost sailors led by his old nemesis, the evil Capt. Salazar, escape from the Devil's Triangle. Jack's only hope of survival lies in seeking out the legendary Trident of Poseidon, but to find it, he must forge an uneasy alliance with a brilliant and beautiful astronomer and a headstrong young man in the British navy.

cast.title: December Boys
cast.overview: For many years, four teenage orphans at an Australian outback convent have watched their younger comrades find new parents, and realize that they may never be adopted. The Reverend Mother sends the four boys away on a seaside vacation, where they meet Teresa and Fearless, a couple who would make perfect parents. The youths compete with one another to be the one Teresa and Fearless decide to adopt.

cast.title: Snare
cast.overview: It's 1997. Distorted guitars rule the world. In an aging Chinese restaurant, a father and his punk-rock son struggle with their familial roles as they realize they each desperately need something from the other.

cast.title: Laura
cast.overview: Two estranged friends stumble upon each other and reconnect over a shared loss.

cast.title: Nineteen
cast.overview: At nineteen the world is every kid's playing field, but when Blake's life turns for the unexpected, he has one opportunity to seize what is means to be human.

cast.title: Untitled Earth Sim 64
cast.overview: A woman is faced with existential crisis after learning that the universe is an untitled simulation.

cast.title: White Lines
cast.overview: When Amber discovers she is pregnant, she hides the news from her fellow drug dealing boyfriend Jacob, who spends his night snorting coke. After a chaotic night at a rave, Ambers future is left fractured and uncertain.

crew.title: Hench
crew.overview: Two evil Henchmen are sent to bury a cofﬁn in the woods. Who or what does it contain? That's out of their pay grade.
